text: 2.1 Employee service agreement: A mandatory financial penalty of Rs. 2,50,000 shall be levied if the trainee departs before completing 36 continuous months of employment.
rationale: Enforces a three-year service bond backed by a Rs. 2,50,000 financial exit penalty.

text: 2.2 The employee executes an employment bond committing to serve for three years, with a promissory note of Rs. 1,20,000 deposited with the company HR department upon joining.
rationale: Requires a graduate trainee to sign a Rs. 1,20,000 promissory note to enforce a multi-year bond.

text: 2.3 Should the candidate fail to accept the full-time placement offer following graduation, a recruitment penalty fee of Rs. 2,00,000 shall become immediately due and payable.
rationale: Penalizes a graduating student with Rs. 2,00,000 for declining a campus placement offer.

text: 4.2 Early Exit Penalty: If the Intern resigns, discontinues, or abandons the internship prior to 30th June 2027 for any reason whatsoever, the Intern shall pay liquidated damages of INR 75,000 within 10 days.
rationale: Assesses INR 75,000 liquidated damages for any early internship withdrawal regardless of cause.

text: 4.3 The Company shall withhold the Internship Completion Certificate, academic evaluation signature, and experience letter until all early exit penalties and alleged damages are settled in full.
rationale: Uses academic credit signatures and completion certificates as leverage to collect exit penalties.

text: In the event the trainee resigns during the 90-day classroom induction, all relocation allowances plus a flat Rs. 70,000 training recovery surcharge must be wired within five business days.
rationale: Adds an unitemized Rs. 70,000 surcharge on top of relocation reimbursement for early exit.

text: The robotics club shall forfeit its Rs. 50,000 hardware grant and pay a 20% administrative recovery charge if the prototype demonstration is absent from the sponsor expo.
rationale: Attaches grant clawback plus a 20% administrative surcharge to student hackathon deliverables.

text: 2.2 Stipend payments are scheduled for the 10th business day of the following month; however, stipend disbursement is contingent upon client project acceptance and subjective manager satisfaction with weekly velocity.
rationale: Makes monthly stipend payout uncertain by tying it to client acceptance and subjective velocity scores.

text: 3. Annual CTC is INR 6,50,000 per annum. Trainee remuneration is subject to statutory tax deduction at source (TDS). Performance bonus and incentives advertised during recruitment are non-binding and payable strictly at the sole and unappealable discretion of management.
rationale: States annual CTC and TDS while making advertised recruitment bonuses non-binding and discretionary.

text: 2.1 The Company shall pay the Intern a monthly stipend of INR 18,000 (Rupees Eighteen Thousand only), subject to applicable statutory deductions, payable via NEFT to the Intern's bank account.
rationale: Establishes base monthly stipend amount and electronic transfer payment method.

text: Sponsor shall release 50% of the INR 2,00,000 title sponsorship upon signing this MOU and the remaining 50% within 10 working days after submission of the post-event photo report.
rationale: Balanced two-tranche sponsorship disbursement providing upfront working capital to students.

text: Disputed timesheet entries submitted by the student contractor will freeze payment of the entire monthly invoice—not merely the contested hours—until resolved.
rationale: Allows withholding of undisputed student earnings whenever a small subset of hours is questioned.

text: 3.1 Prior to onboarding, the Intern shall pay a training and equipment security deposit of INR 15,000 (Rupees Fifteen Thousand only) via bank transfer.
rationale: Requires an upfront INR 15,000 security deposit from a student intern before starting work.

text: 3.2 Refund Conditions: Subject to full completion of the 6-month internship duration, clearance of all no-dues checklists, and satisfactory evaluation, the deposit shall be refunded within 90 days of exit.
rationale: Delays deposit refund up to 90 days and conditions return on subjective performance evaluation.

text: 3.3 Forfeiture Condition: In the event the Intern withdraws before completing the 6-month term, is dismissed for disciplinary reasons, or fails to meet internal performance metrics, the entire security deposit shall be forfeited to the Company.
rationale: Allows total deposit forfeiture for subjective performance ratings or early withdrawal.

text: The student club must lodge a Rs. 40,000 auditorium damage deposit with the venue operator; refunds will be processed within 21 working days minus actual verified repair invoices.
rationale: Reasonable venue deposit with clear 21-day refund timeline and invoice-backed deductions.

text: An equipment usage deposit of Rs. 10,000 paid by the student videographer shall be refunded within 7 business days after returning cameras and microphones in working order.
rationale: Clear, short 7-day refund window for returned student contractor gear.

text: 5.1 Termination by Company: The Company may terminate this Agreement at any time, with or without cause, immediately upon written notice and without severance or notice pay.
rationale: Allows immediate without-cause termination by the company with zero notice pay.

text: 5.2 Termination by Intern: The Intern must provide at least 60 (sixty) days prior written notice to terminate this Agreement. No academic exam leave may be taken during the notice period.
rationale: Requires 60 days' intern notice and bans university exam leave during notice.

text: 6.1 Either party may terminate this agreement by providing thirty (30) days prior written notice, or payment of stipend in lieu thereof.
rationale: Balanced mutual 30-day written notice clause with buyout option.

text: 6.2 Immediate summary dismissal shall apply without right of appeal in cases of alleged misconduct, breach of confidentiality, or insubordination.
rationale: Permits summary dismissal upon mere allegation with no hearing or appeal right.

text: Either the sponsor or the student organizing committee may terminate this sponsorship MOU with 30 days' prior written notice, provided documented non-cancellable vendor costs are settled fairly.
rationale: Balanced cancellation clause protecting student organizers against sunk vendor expenses.

text: Either party may end this freelance student engagement upon 10 business days' written notice, and all completed milestones delivered prior to termination shall be paid in full.
rationale: Mutual 10-day termination notice guaranteeing full payment for completed work.

text: Employer reserves the sole right to place the trainee on unpaid indefinite furlough without terminating the contract, barring the trainee from accepting alternative employment.
rationale: Locks trainee into unpaid indefinite furlough without pay or freedom to leave.

text: 6.2 Portfolio and Gag Restriction: The Intern is strictly prohibited from mentioning the Company name, project architecture, or technologies used on their resume, CV, LinkedIn profile, or academic viva presentation, and agrees never to post negative comments or Glassdoor reviews about the Company.
rationale: Prevents academic viva presentation, resume listing, and public commentary.

text: 6.1 The Intern agrees to hold in strict confidence all proprietary source code, data pipelines, client lists, pricing models, and business strategies indefinitely, even after termination of this Agreement.
rationale: Perpetual confidentiality obligation with no expiration window or public-domain carve-out.

text: Any unauthorized screenshot, email forwarding, or cloud backup of internal customer datasets constitutes a material confidentiality breach entitling the company to immediate injunctive relief.
rationale: Protects sensitive customer datasets while introducing injunctive relief exposure.

text: The student organizing committee agrees not to disclose the sponsor's custom pricing tier or internal marketing campaign roadmap to rival sponsors for twelve months following the festival.
rationale: Narrow, time-limited commercial confidentiality appropriate for event sponsorship.

text: Both parties agree to maintain mutual confidentiality regarding non-public business plans, API credentials, and personal financial details exchanged during the engagement for two years.
rationale: Reciprocal, balanced two-year confidentiality clause protecting both sides.

text: 5.1 Work created specifically under company direction using company equipment shall be deemed 'work made for hire' belonging to the employer.
rationale: Narrow, standard work-made-for-hire assignment limited to directed company work.

text: 5.2 Student agrees that all intellectual property conceived on personal time during weekends while employed shall automatically vest in the company.
rationale: Captures off-hours weekend inventions unrelated to company duties.

text: 7.1 All inventions, software code, scripts, machine learning models, documentation, and designs created by the Intern during the internship term—whether created during office hours or on personal devices outside working hours—shall belong exclusively to the Company.
rationale: Overbroad 24/7 IP assignment reaching personal laptops and non-working hours.

text: 7.2 The Intern hereby assigns worldwide ownership and waives all moral rights, authorship attribution, and inventorship claims for any work or academic capstone project referencing concepts learned during the internship.
rationale: Captures university capstone work and waives moral attribution rights.

text: Participating student hackathon teams retain 100% ownership of source code, hardware designs, and startup prototypes built during the event; sponsors receive no equity or IP rights.
rationale: Protects student innovators' ownership over hackathon builds.

text: Upon full payment of milestone invoices, copyright in the bespoke client website deliverables transfers to the client, while the student developer retains reuse rights to generic utility components.
rationale: Fair freelance IP transfer tied to payment while preserving reusable developer utilities.

text: 4.1 Restraint of trade: Intern is prohibited from accepting employment with any competitor within the territory for one full year following departure.
rationale: Restrains a graduating student from working for any competitor for one year.

text: 4.3 For 18 months post-internship, the student is barred from joining any fintech startup, software company, or entering graduate studies in the same domain.
rationale: Extreme restraint barring both industry employment and graduate university studies.

text: The student organizing committee agrees not to invite any competing beverage or telecom brand as a co-sponsor for the same annual festival edition.
rationale: Standard single-event category exclusivity appropriate for a title festival sponsor.

text: For six months after contract expiration, the student contractor agrees not to directly solicit the specific named end-client introduced by the agency solely to bypass agency fees.
rationale: Narrowly scoped 6-month non-circumvention limited to one introduced client.

text: Any breach of this global non-compete covenant entitles the employer to an ex-parte injunction plus liquidated damages equal to twenty-four months of gross CTC.
rationale: Backs a global restraint of trade with two years' salary in liquidated damages.

text: 7.1 The student agrees to pay all attorney fees and litigation costs incurred by the employer in enforcing any clause of this agreement.
rationale: One-sided fee-shifting forcing a student to fund all employer litigation costs.

text: 7.2 Company's total aggregate liability arising out of this agreement shall be limited to the total fees paid to the student in the preceding one month.
rationale: Asymmetrically caps employer liability at one month's pay while leaving student liability uncapped.

text: Student organizing committee members act strictly in their institutional representative capacity and assume no personal financial liability for university club obligations.
rationale: Protects volunteer student club officers from personal financial liability.

text: The freelance student developer provides experimental hackathon and beta prototypes on an 'as-is' basis and disclaims implied warranties of merchantability or uninterrupted uptime.
rationale: Standard warranty disclaimer appropriate for student prototype development.

text: The graduate engineer must reimburse the bank for all regulatory investigation costs and external counsel retainers if any internal audit flags documentation authored by the trainee.
rationale: Shifts corporate regulatory audit and external law-firm fees onto a junior trainee.

text: 8. All disputes shall be settled by binding arbitration in Singapore under SIAC rules, with arbitration costs borne solely by the student.
rationale: Mandates expensive overseas SIAC arbitration in Singapore paid exclusively by the student.

text: 8.1 This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of India. Any disputes arising hereunder shall first be referred to good-faith conciliation, failing which the competent courts at Bengaluru, Karnataka shall have exclusive jurisdiction.
rationale: Reasonable Indian governing law, good-faith conciliation, and local Bengaluru jurisdiction.

text: Either party may elect online video-conferenced mediation through a neutral campus-approved mediator prior to approaching local civil courts in Hyderabad.
rationale: Low-cost remote mediation option paired with local jurisdiction.

text: Mandatory pre-litigation mediation shall be conducted in good faith for 21 days; if unresolved, either party may file suit before the competent courts of Chennai.
rationale: Balanced mediation-first dispute clause with local city courts.

text: The employer retains the unilateral option to pursue court injunctions in any jurisdiction worldwide while confining all employee claims strictly to private arbitration in Dubai.
rationale: One-sided forum clause granting employer worldwide court access while forcing trainee to Dubai arbitration.

text: 1.1 The Intern is appointed as a Data Engineering Intern for a fixed duration of 6 (six) months, commencing on 1st January 2027 and concluding on 30th June 2027.
rationale: Standard role title and fixed 6-month internship start/end dates.

text: 1.2 The Intern shall commit 40 hours per week (Monday to Friday, 9:30 AM to 6:30 PM IST) in a hybrid work arrangement and report directly to the Lead Data Architect.
rationale: Clearly specifies weekly working hours, hybrid mode, and reporting mentor.

text: Neither party shall be liable for delay or non-performance caused by force majeure events such as floods, earthquakes, epidemics, or government lockdowns, without financial penalty to either side.
rationale: Balanced mutual force majeure clause without one-sided refund penalties.

text: Official notices under this Agreement shall be sent in writing via registered email to the designated contact addresses listed in Schedule A, deemed received on the next business day.
rationale: Clear, modern electronic notice procedure.

text: Sponsor logos, promotional banners, and booth artwork shall be provided in print-ready vector format at least ten (10) days prior to the festival opening ceremony.
rationale: Reasonable operational deadline for sponsor branding assets.

text: Neither party may assign its rights or delegate core obligations under this Agreement to an unrelated third party without obtaining the other party's prior written consent.
rationale: Balanced mutual anti-assignment boilerplate.
